description: The KL-72 RTO is a Sub-Regional Transport Office (SRTO) located in Mananthavady, serving the northern part of the Wayanad district. It functions under the main Wayanad RTO (KL-12) and facilitates vehicle registration, licensing, and taxation for the Mananthavady taluk region.
address: 5th Mile, Kellur P.O., Mananthavady, Wayanad, Kerala
